svg.title: The Yeo-Johnson power transform of Equation 3 for five values of lambda
svg.desc: Left: psi(h; lambda) plotted against h from -4 to 4 for lambda = 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2. All curves pass through the origin with slope one; lambda = 1 is the identity line; lambda below 1 bends the right tail down and the left tail further down, lambda above 1 does the opposite. Right: two number lines showing where evenly spaced inputs land under lambda = 0.5: large positive values are pulled together, large negative values are spread apart.
svg.text: Eq 3: ψ(h; λ), one curve per λ
right tail pulled in, left tail pushed out
